info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Compliance By Param1-spec
info.description: The Fraud Resolution Compliance Retrieval API allows users to access compliance information related to fraud resolution by providing specific parameters. This endpoint supports developers in retrieving relevant compliance data necessary for completing fraud-related evaluations and assessments. It is typically used by risk management teams and compliance officers in financial institutions. By leveraging this API, consumers can enhance their decision-making processes and ensure adherence to regulatory standards.

get.summary: Retrieve the details of a specific fraud resolution entry.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a particular fraud resolution identified by the given ID. You can use this information for review, audit, or compliance purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve fraud resolution information for a specific resolution identifier. Ensure the request is properly formatted to access the relevant compliance data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested fraud resolution details.
